title: Reminder: Outdoor Market in Gouache
content: Eugene Galien Laloue (1854 - 1941) La Gare de l'Est.39 by 69.5cm., 15 1/2 by 27 1/4 in.gouache on paperIn case you missed the announcement late last month, I've issued the challenge to paint an outdoor market in gouache using three colors and white.Charles Walter Simpson, 1885-1971 Newlyn fish market, gouacheHere's a link tothe original blog post, and there are already some exciting entries being uploaded to theFacebook Event page.  The deadline is August 31.------Own the 72-minute feature "Gouache in the Wild"• HD MP4Download at Gumroad$14.95• or HD MP4Download at Sellfy(for Paypal customers) $14.95• DVD atPurchase at Kunaki.com(Region 1 encoded NTSC video) $24.50
